title: Ryser’s \(r\)-partite hypergraph conjecture
statement: Every r-uniform r-partite hypergraph satisfies τ≤(r−1)ν, where τ is its transversal number and ν its matching number.

counterexample.description: An r-partite hypergraph encoded by part sizes and one local coordinate per part for each edge, with exact transversal number τ greater than (r−1) times its exact matching number ν.
